sources.title: Jim Farley biography preview
sources.findings: Public preview identifies American manager born June 10, 1962 in Buenos Aires.
sources.caution: Read public preview only, not paywalled full biography; use university economics major rather than uncorroborated dual bachelors.

sources.title: May 16, 2026 commencement report
sources.findings: Class of 1985 economics major; addressed 2026 commencement and received honorary Doctorate of Humane Letters.
sources.caution: Honorary degree is not earned research doctorate; report read, video not watched.

sources.title: October 28, 2026 CEO certification
sources.findings: Signed by James D. Farley Jr. as president and CEO for September 30 quarter report.
sources.caution: Certification is not an independent audit or evidence of future targets achieved.

sources.title: Farley elected to McDonald’s board
sources.findings: February 10, 2026 release specifies effective date February 4; Ford CEO/director.
sources.caution: McDonald’s director not CEO; announcement and effective dates distinguished.

sources.title: August 4, 2020 CEO succession filing
sources.findings: President, CEO and director appointments effective October 1, 2020.
sources.caution: August announcement not assumption of office; predecessor later employment retirement is separate.

sources.title: 2020 chief operating officer appointment
sources.findings: COO effective March 1, 2020; prior president New Businesses, Technology and Strategy.
sources.caution: Report earliest event February 6; public announcement February 7, neither is effective date.

sources.title: October 1, 2020 operational changes
sources.findings: Opening pages confirm actual CEO succession and outline commercial software and electric vehicle plans.
sources.caution: Historical plans not proof of current strategy or achieved margins; no ongoing Argo AI claim.

sources.title: 2022 speaker biography
sources.findings: Toyota strategic planning 1990; Ford November 2007; Georgetown economics bachelor, UCLA Anderson management degree.
sources.caution: No UCLA graduation year or MBA inferred here; Noyce award recipient was Lip-Bu Tan, not Farley; planned keynote not proof of attendance.

sources.title: 2021 proxy biography, page 30
sources.findings: Ford November 2007 and Europe/Middle East/Africa leadership 2015–17; CEO October 1, 2020.
sources.caution: Read Farley biography section, not entire proxy. Ford board chair and CEO separate.
